text:
GTA 6 has multiple endings shaped by your choices, relationship stage with Lucia, criminal profile, and family savings.

In the finale, after grabbing the hard drive of dirt on the senator, cops trap you on a bridge.

Choice 1: Jump. Jason hands Lucia the drive then lets go so she escapes. He gets arrested. She takes the deal, raises their son Tomás, and visits him in prison later.

Choice 2: Fight. Both die in the shootout holding hands.

Rockstar says way more than two variants exist. After credits the game rewinds pre-finale so you can free roam or try again.

A GTA 6 player discovered a method/glitch to play in first-person mode, which seems to be functional.

- Settings → Controller → Touch Pad Button → change to Camera
- Sit in the driver’s seat and pull out the phone by pressing ↑ on the d-pad
- Put your phone away by pressing circle/B then spam your touch pad button
- Do this a couple times and it should work
- You have to reload your save to return to 3rd person

(Source: https://youtu.be/CJi2DWXxsoQ)
